scope: Read-only review of private-store committed-case receipt recovery; no native restart/restore authority.
reviewed_invariants: The getter reads self.case and requires all nine literal AdmissionIntent fields to match; unknown case and mismatched intent remain distinct errors.
The getter only clones the existing store owner Arc and returns admission_undo=None; it calls neither admission preparation/commit nor authority.now/admission.
Book, resource totals, journal head, epoch and initial supply remain unchanged, including after authority removal or admission expiry.
Recovered handles still pass the existing store-owner check and current-case lookup; foreign identical stores cannot consume them.

New admission remains subject to current authority and expiry. Existing recovered cases retain service/close deduplication and ordinary LIFO undo; a recovered handle does not obtain the original admission undo.
limits: All test/Clippy executions were performed by root; this reviewer only inspected source, raw logs and source hashes.
A recovered private handle is not proof of native history, live UTXO funding, resource leases or restart/import validity.

A4 must validate its current root/generation, signed Result and committed view before binding its coordinator receipt; equality of a private intent does not establish native lineage or defeat rollback ABA.
The separately developed node A2 due-update adapter is outside this leaf recovery review.
